# Bundle the worker as a plain script. WorkerScript module loading varies
# between Qt versions, particularly when its dependencies are in resources.
set(worker_sources Shared/DateUtils.mjs Events/EventLogic.mjs Views/MonthCacheWorker.mjs)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${worker_sources})
file(READ "Shared/DateUtils.mjs" worker_dates)
file(READ "Events/EventLogic.mjs" worker_events)
file(READ "Views/MonthCacheWorker.mjs" worker_body)
foreach(module IN ITEMS worker_dates worker_events worker_body)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "(^|\n)import [^\n]+\n" "\n" ${module} "${${module}}")
    string(REPLACE "export function " "function " ${module} "${${module}}")
endforeach()
set(worker_script
"const Dates = (() => {
${worker_dates}
return {makeDate, addDays};
})();
const Events = (() => {
${worker_events}
return {date, key, forEachSegment};
})();
${worker_body}")
set(worker_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/worker/MonthCacheWorker.js")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${worker_file}" CONTENT "${worker_script}")
set_source_files_properties("${worker_file}" PROPERTIES QT_RESOURCE_ALIAS "MonthCacheWorker.js")

    PREFIX "/qt/qml/CalendarWorkers"
